d: We honour God when we surrender totally to Him (Psalms 37:5; 55:22).
One of the ways to give God glory is to acknowledge Him in all that we do (Proverbs 3:6; Jeremiah 9:23-24); when this is done in complete obedience, it is accompanied by prosperity (Job 36:11).

We also give pleasure to God when we do the following: live uprightly (1 Chronicles 29:17); stay away from anything that defiles (Ezra 10:11); trust Him (Psalm 36:7-8); do His will (Psalm 103:21); seek to know Him for His greatness (Genesis 5:24; Hebrews 11:5); fear Him and hope in His mercy (Psalm 147:10-11).
